article:
For each question, write the correct answer. Write one word for each gap.

[--- Table Start ---]
| Science-fiction film Hi Sam,  Have you seen the new science-fiction film, Rocket? I was really interested in seeing it because it was based (27)…………… the book called Spacemen, which is (28)…………… my favourite novels. To be honest, I always find (29)…………… difficult when something that I've read and enjoyed is turned into a film, because it's never exactly the same as I imagined! But (30)…………… time I really wasn't disappointed - the acting was great, and the main characters were very similar to how the author described them in the novel.  (31)…………… you haven't seen it yet, why don't you come round to my house and watch it online (32)……………? I know you love science fiction, so it would be great to hear what you think of the film!  Let me know! Carys |
[--- Table End ---]

explanations.27:
原因：“be based on” 固定搭配，表 “基于”，指电影基于小说改编。
词汇点：base A on B（A 基于 B），被动结构为 be based on，如 “The story is based on real events.”
explanations.28:
原因：“among my favourite novels” 表 “在我最喜欢的小说中”，或 “one of my favourite novels” 表 “最喜欢的小说之一”。
语法点：among + 复数名词表 “在…… 中”，one of + 复数名词表 “…… 之一”
explanations.29:
原因：形式宾语 it，真正宾语为 “when something...is turned into a film”，表 “发现很难”。
语法点：find it + adj. + to do/that 从句，如 “I find it interesting to learn English.”
explanations.30:
原因：“this time” 表 “这次”，与前文 “always” 形成对比，强调这次未失望。
词汇点：this/that time 表特定某次，如 “This time I won't make the same mistake.”
explanations.31:
原因：条件句引导词，“如果你还没看”，主句用建议语气。
语法点：if 引导条件句，主句可用祈使句 / 情态动词，如 “If you are free, come to my house.”
explanations.32:
原因：“watch it online together” 表 “一起在线观看”，强调共同行动。
词汇点：together 为副词，表 “共同”，如 “Let's go together.”
